title: Selective labeling and visualization of viral and bacterial neuraminidases using ortho-quinone methide-based probes
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00170F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Erianna I. Alvarado-Melendez, Simon T. Ruessink, Karin Strijbis, Tom Wennekes
Highly selective ortho-quinone methide probes covalently label and visualize viral and bacterial neuraminidases, revealing enzyme activity and localization in complex samples with minimal off-target effects.
